concepts.why: The patient's symptoms and radiographic findings, including a ground-glass trabecular pattern and well-defined margin, are consistent with juvenile ossifying fibroma.
Although less likely, fibrous dysplasia is considered due to the patient's age and the presence of a hard, nontender swelling in the right buccal vestibule.

rationales.F05: The ground-glass trabecular pattern is more typical of juvenile ossifying fibroma.
rationales.F07: The well-defined margin and ground-glass internal pattern are characteristic of juvenile ossifying fibroma.
rationales.F10: The well-defined margin is unlike fibrous dysplasia, which typically has an ill-defined margin.

frontier_selector.rationale: The well-defined margin and ground-glass internal pattern on imaging, along with the absence of ill-defined margins and merging with surrounding areas, support juvenile ossifying fibroma over fibrous dysplasia.
